fn io() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::io::Error> {
    ::std::result::Result::Ok(1)
}

fn io_again() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::io::Error> {
    ::std::result::Result::Ok(2)
}

fn parse() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::core::num::ParseIntError> {
    "3".parse::<u32>()
}

fn read() -> u32 { io().unwrap() }
fn number() -> u32 { parse().unwrap() }
fn pair() -> u32 { read() + number() }
fn left() -> u32 { pair() }
fn right() -> u32 { pair() + read() }
fn diamond() -> u32 { left() + right() }

fn recursive_a(depth: u32) -> u32 {
    if depth == 0 { read() } else { recursive_b(depth - 1) }
}
fn recursive_b(depth: u32) -> u32 {
    if depth == 0 { number() } else { recursive_a(depth - 1) }
}
fn empty_recursion(depth: u32) -> u32 {
    if depth == 0 { 0 } else { empty_recursion(depth - 1) }
}

fn handled() -> u32 { io().unwrap_or(0) + io().unwrap_or_default() }
fn handled_bool() -> bool { io().is_ok() && parse().is_err() }

fn consume(value: u32) -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::io::Error> {
    ::std::result::Result::Ok(value)
}
fn argument() -> u32 { consume(number()).unwrap_or(0) }
fn distinct_origins() -> u32 { io().unwrap() + io_again().unwrap() }

fn unknown() -> u32 {
    let _ = ::std::env::var("CORDIAL_SPECIMEN_MISSING");
    read()
}
fn unknown_caller() -> u32 { unknown() }
fn unknown_recursive_a(depth: u32) -> u32 {
    if depth == 0 { unknown() } else { unknown_recursive_b(depth - 1) }
}
fn unknown_recursive_b(depth: u32) -> u32 { unknown_recursive_a(depth) }
fn unmodeled_method() -> u32 { read().wrapping_add(1) }
fn discarded_result() { let _ = io(); }
fn indirect(call: fn() -> u32) -> u32 { call() }

fn optional() -> ::std::option::Option<u32> { ::std::option::Option::Some(5) }
fn unproven_handler() -> u32 { optional().unwrap_or(0) }
fn residual() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::std::io::Error> { io()?; io() }
fn infallible() -> ::std::result::Result<u32, ::core::convert::Infallible> {
    ::std::result::Result::Ok(0)
}
fn infallible_use() -> u32 { infallible().unwrap() }

fn main() {
    let _ = (diamond(), recursive_a(3), empty_recursion(2), handled(), handled_bool(),
        argument(), distinct_origins(), unknown_caller(), unknown_recursive_a(2),
        unmodeled_method(), indirect(read), unproven_handler(), residual(), infallible_use());
    discarded_result();
}
